title: Crouching Little Boy by House Walkway, 1948 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square snapshot with deckled edges depicting a curly-haired young boy crouching low on a concrete sidewalk beside a suburban house. He wears a button-strap summer sunsuit or romper with dark sandals. The backdrop shows the corner of a residential building featuring horizontal siding, a red brick base, a gutter downspout, and an evergreen bush. Taken during the early post-WWII baby boom era, this candid captures typical everyday domestic childhood in mid-twentieth-century America.
